remarks: Welcome to easy first-floor living in the desirable Berkley Square Villas! This well-maintained 2-bedroom, 2-full bath condo offers a bright, open layout designed for comfort and convenience. The fully applianced kitchen features granite countertops, a breakfast bar, and a pantry, flowing seamlessly into the living and dining areas. Enjoy the convenience of first-floor laundry and the peace of mind that comes with a newer furnace(2023) and central air (2023). The full basement has 8-foot ceilings and provides exceptional storage or future finishing potential. Step outside to the covered rear porch overlooking a peaceful, tree-lined green space—an ideal setting for morning coffee or evening relaxation. The detached one-car garage is conveniently located directly across from the unit. Low-maintenance living in a sought-after Hamburg community close to shopping, dining, and everyday conveniences!
